{{Top|leg}}
A '''Rodian skip-trawler''' was a high-maintenance [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] that was considered the most temperamental of its kind in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
